secrets.name: Snagged fishing chain
secrets.text: A corroded length of fishing gear lies against the canyon floor, partly covered by sediment.

secrets.name: Mudslide scar
secrets.text: A small exposed ledge marks a local sediment slump along the canyon slope.

secrets.name: Whale vertebrae
secrets.text: A short run of whale vertebrae rests on the lower canyon floor. Bones can remain after soft tissue is consumed.
